name: block-auth-card
summary: Sign-in and sign-up card shell with logo, alternative actions, form slot, footer, and legal text.
description: A Web block that frames authentication pages: brand mark, page heading, optional alternative sign-in actions with a divider, a slot for the caller's form, a footer line for switching between sign-in and sign-up, and legal text. It contains no authentication logic: the existing auth feature's forms and session handling stay in charge. Built from the Card and Separator primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props.
use_when: sign-in, sign-up, or password pages need a consistent framed layout
the builder asks for a login or registration card design
single sign-on buttons should sit above the email form with a divider
